# ChartsAI

> Free browser-based chart makers and printable trackers, designed and built by SupaMakers. Original fictional examples, explicit calculations, and reusable source code.

## Tools
- [Dot plot maker](https://www.chartsai.com/dot-plot-maker/): Frequency dot plots from up to 300 numeric observations. Editable examples, data table, PNG, SVG, PDF and CSV export.
- [Radar chart maker](https://www.chartsai.com/radar-chart-maker/): Compare 1–5 series across 3–10 dimensions with an explicit shared scale. PNG, SVG, PDF and CSV export.
- [Habit tracker printable](https://www.chartsai.com/printables/habit-tracker/): Custom weekly and monthly blank trackers, up to 8 habits, A4 or US Letter landscape PDF.

## Context
- [Methodology and authorship](https://www.chartsai.com/about/): Calculations, limits, original samples and SupaMakers attribution.
- [Source code and reuse](https://www.chartsai.com/source/): MIT-licensed implementation and downloadable sample data.
- [Privacy](https://www.chartsai.com/privacy/): Inputs and file generation stay in the browser. No cloud saving or third-party analytics.

## Important distinctions
- All sample data is fictional, not a research dataset.
- Missing values are not silently converted to zero.
- Radar polygon area is not an overall score.
- The printable tracker is blank; it does not store completion history or provide health advice.
- No accounts, payments or watermarks are required for current tools.
- Search visibility or AI citations are not guaranteed by this file.
